$comment: Skills installed from public GitHub repos into ~/.claude/skills and kept current by `npx agent-cloud skills`. auto: true updates them on their own once a day (only after you've reviewed one update); other sources wait for `npx agent-cloud skills update --yes`. A skill you edit by hand is never overwritten. Add a skill with its folder name; 'prefix' is the folder that holds a repo's skills (default skills/). New PC: `npx agent-cloud skills update --yes --install`.
